description: GET /setup-status — the one daemon route a browser page may read cross-origin (Access-Control-Allow-Origin: *), so it carries no secret. Both daemons answer with exactly these keys: bridge/src/setup-status.ts (Node) and DaemonServer.setupStatusPayload (Swift). Replayed by bridge/src/__tests__/setup-status.test.ts and apple/AgentDeckTests/SetupStatusContractTests.swift.
